tools.name: myonlinestore_get_store
tools.description: Get the shop's own details: name, primary domain, currency, default and active languages, prices-include-tax setting and business models. Good first call to check the connection. GET /v1/store.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_shipping_methods
tools.description: List the shipping methods the shop offers: display name, countries served, default flag and the free-shipping threshold. GET /v1/shipping/methods.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_articles
tools.description: List the shop's articles (products) with name, SKU, price and stock. Filter by ids, uuids or created/changed dates. GET /v1/articles.

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_article
tools.description: Get one article (product) by its id. Set use_url_id to true when the id is the one shown in the article page URL. GET /v1/articles/{article_id}.

tools.name: myonlinestore_count_articles
tools.description: Count the shop's articles, optionally within a created or changed date range. GET /v1/articles/count.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_categories
tools.description: List the shop's categories with title, parent, visibility and sort order. Set as_tree to get the nested tree. GET /v1/categories.

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_category
tools.description: Get one category by id: title, content, SEO fields, parent and sorting. GET /v1/categories/{category_id}.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_category_articles
tools.description: List the articles that belong to one category. GET /v1/categories/{category_id}/articles.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_customers
tools.description: List the shop's customers. Search with q (name, email or similar). Set embed to address to include addresses. GET /v1/customers. Contains personal data.

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Contains personal data. GET /v1/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_customer_addresses
tools.description: List the saved addresses of one customer. Contains personal data. GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/addresses.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with status, date, currency, discount code and payment status. Filter by order date, status, status change, customer email or customer id. GET /v1/orders. Contains personal data.

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its order number: status, dates, currency, discount code, payment status and the price block. Contains personal data. GET /v1/orders/{order_number}.

tools.name: myonlinestore_count_orders
tools.description: Count orders, optionally filtered by order date, status or status change. GET /v1/orders/count.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_order_payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded on one order. GET /v1/orders/{order_number}/payments.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_discount_codes
tools.description: List the shop's discount codes: the code, percentage or fixed discount, validity dates and active flag. Filter by active state or validity. GET /v1/discountcodes.

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_discount_code
tools.description: Get one discount code by its code text: discount values, validity dates, minimum order rules and single-use flag. GET /v1/discountcodes/{code}.

tools.name: myonlinestore_list_newsletter_subscribers
tools.description: List newsletter subscribers with their activation state and dates. Filter by activation or created/changed dates. GET /v1/newsletter/subscribers. Contains personal data.

tools.name: myonlinestore_get_newsletter_subscriber
tools.description: Get one newsletter subscriber by email address. Contains personal data. GET /v1/newsletter/subscribers/{email}.

tools.name: myonlinestore_count_newsletter_subscribers
tools.description: Count newsletter subscribers, optionally filtered by activation or created/changed dates. GET /v1/newsletter/subscribers/count.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "myonlinestore_get_discount_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: myonlinestore_get_article, myonlinestore_list_customers, myonlinestore_list_orders, myonlinestore_get_newsletter_subscriber · Public sink: myonlinestore_list_customers, myonlinestore_list_orders, myonlinestore_get_newsletter_subscriber.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: myonlinestore_get_article, myonlinestore_list_customers, myonlinestore_list_orders, myonlinestore_get_newsletter_subscriber · Public sink: myonlinestore_list_customers, myonlinestore_list_orders, myonlinestore_get_newsletter_subscriber

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
